about.registryInfo: Assetiko Commodities Ltd. is named on the Assetiko product page as the issuer of the token. The Assetiko group Legal Notices list only four sister British Virgin Islands Business Companies (Assetiko Holdings Ltd., Assetiko Digital Assets Ltd., Assetiko Treasury Ltd., Assetiko Operations Ltd.), all at the shared registered agent address Craigmuir Chambers, Road Town, Tortola VG 1110, and Assetiko Commodities Ltd. is not explicitly enumerated in that list as of this review. BVI company registration numbers are not published. The Assetiko group explicitly disclaims being a broker, investment adviser, financial adviser, exchange, bank, or custodian, and no financial regulator is identified. Founding team, directors, and officers are not disclosed publicly, and no LinkedIn company page or verified Twitter presence exists as of this review. Custodian identity, vault operator, insurance carrier, auditor, and independent attestation reports are classified as "Restricted Records" available only upon identity-verified request. The row is flagged Suspicious pending publication of a named custodian, a named independent auditor with a reserves attestation, on-chain proof of reserves, and a verifiable regulator or licence. Assetiko's stated reserve methodology for XAGa is one hundred percent physical silver with a claimed coverage of approximately one hundred and two point three percent. The current on-chain footprint of the XAGa issuer wallet is de minimis with a small handful of trustline holders and a single automated market maker liquidity provider account, and issuer activation on the XRP Ledger occurred within the last week of this review.
